plan: Haggai 1:15b–2:9; Zechariah 1:1-6; Haggai 2:10-19; Ezra 5:2; Haggai 2:20-23; Zechariah 1:7-17, 18-21; Zechariah 2:1-5, 6-13; Zechariah 3:1-10; Zechariah 4:1-14; Zechariah 5:1-4, 5-11

readings.title: The Future Glory of the Temple
readings.subtitle: The Delight of All Nations Shall Come
readings.text: [Haggai 2:1] In the seventh month, on the twenty-first of the new moon, the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came by Ḥaggai the prophet, saying, [2] <dq>“Speak, please, to Zerubbaḇel son of She’alti’ěl, governor of Yehuḏah, and to Yehoshua son of Yehotsaḏaq, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying, [3] Who is there left among you who saw this House in its former esteem? And how do you see it now? Is it not in your eyes as naught when compared to it? [4] And now, be strong, Zerubbaḇel,’</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. <dq>‘And be strong, Yehoshua, son of Yehotsaḏaq, the high priest. And be strong, all you people of the land,’</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>’and work. For <dn>I</dn> am with you,’</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts – [5] <dq>the Word that <dn>I</dn> covenanted with <dn>את</dn> you when you came out of Mitsrayim, and <dn>My</dn> Spirit is remaining in your midst, do not fear!’ [6] For thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, ‘Once more, in a little while, and <dn>I</dn> am shaking the heavens and earth, the sea and dry land. [7] And <dn>I</dn> shall shake all the nations, and they shall come to the Delight of all the nations, and <dn>I</dn> shall fill this House with esteem,’</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts. [8] <dq>The silver is <dn>Mine</dn>, and the gold is <dn>Mine</dn>,’</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts. [9] <dq>Let the esteem of this latter House be greater than the former,’</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts. <dq>‘And in this place <dn>I</dn> give peace,’</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts.”

readings.title: A Call to Repentance
readings.subtitle: Return to Me, and I Will Return to You
readings.text: [Zechariah 1:1] In the eighth new moon of the second year of Dareyavesh, the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to Zeḵaryah son of Bereḵyah, son of Iddo the prophet, saying, [2] <dq>“<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was very wroth with your fathers. [3] And you shall say to them, ‘Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, “Turn back to <dn>Me</dn>,” declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, “and <dn>I</dn> shall turn back to you,” declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts. [4] Do not be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying, ‘Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, “Turn back now from your evil ways and your evil deeds.” ’ But they did not obey or give heed to <dn>Me</dn>,” declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [5] Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever? [6] But <dn>My</dn> words and <dn>My</dn> laws, which <dn>I</dn> commanded <dn>My</dn> servants the prophets, did they not overtake <dn>את</dn> your fathers?” “Then they turned back and said, ‘As <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts planned to do to us, according to our ways and according to our deeds, so <dn>He</dn> has done with us.’ ” ’ ”</dq>

readings.title: Defilement and Blessing
readings.subtitle: From This Day On I Shall Bless You
readings.text: [Haggai 2:10] On the twenty-fourth of the ninth month, in the second year of Dareyavesh, the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came unto Ḥaggai the prophet, saying, [11] <dq>“Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, ‘Now, ask the priests concerning the Torah, saying, [12] “If one bears set-apart meat in the fold of his garment, and with the edge he touches bread or stew, or wine or oil, or any food, is it set-apart?” ’ ”</dq> And the priests answered and said, “No.” [13] And Ḥaggai said, “If someone defiled by a dead body touches any of these, is it defiled?” And the priests answered and said, “It is defiled.” [14] And Ḥaggai answered and said, “ <dq>‘So is this people, and so is this nation before <dn>Me</dn>,’</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>’and so is every work of their hands. And whatever they bring near there is defiled. [15] But now, please consider, from this day onward: Before a stone was laid on a stone in the Hěḵal of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, [16] since those days – one came to a heap of twenty ěphahs, and there were ten; one came to the winepress to draw out fifty baths from the press, and there were twenty – [17] <dn>I</dn> struck <dn>את</dn> you with blight and mildew and hail in all the labours of your hands, and there was none of you with <dn>Me</dn>,’</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [18] <dq>Consider now from this day forward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, from the day that the foundation of the Hěḵal of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was laid, consider it: [19] Is the seed yet in the storehouse? And until now the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree have not yielded fruit! From this day on <dn>I</dn> shall bless you!’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Work on the Temple Resumes
readings.subtitle: Zerubbabel and Yeshua Begin to Build
readings.text: [Ezra 5:2] Then Zerubbaḇel son of She’alti’ěl and Yěshua son of Yotsaḏaq rose up and began to build the House of <dn>Elah</dn> which is in Yerushalayim. And the prophets of <dn>Elah</dn> were with them, helping them.

readings.title: A Promise to Zerubbabel
readings.subtitle: I Will Make You as a Signet
readings.text: [Haggai 2:20] And a second time the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to Ḥaggai on the twenty-fourth day of the new moon, saying, [21] <dq>“Speak to Zerubbaḇel, the governor of Yehuḏah, saying, ‘<dn>I</dn> am shaking the heavens and earth. [22] And <dn>I</dn> shall overturn the throne of reigns. And <dn>I</dn> shall destroy the might of the reigns of the nations, and overturn the chariots and their riders. And the horses and their riders shall come down, each by the sword of his brother. [23] In that day,’</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, <dq>‘<dn>I</dn> shall take you, Zerubbaḇel <dn>My</dn> servant, son of She’alti’ěl,’</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>’and shall make you as a signet, for <dn>I</dn> have chosen you,’</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts.”

readings.title: The Vision of the Horses
readings.subtitle: My House Shall Be Built in Jerusalem
readings.text: [Zechariah 1:7] On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh new moon, which is the new moon Sheḇat, in the second year of Dareyavesh, the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to Zeḵaryah son of Bereḵyahu, son of Iddo the prophet, saying, [8] “I looked at night and saw a man riding on a red horse, and he was standing among the myrtle trees in the shade. And behind him were horses: red, sorrel, and white.” [9] And I said, “My master, what are these?” And the messenger who was speaking to me said to me, “Let me show you what they are.” [10] And the man who stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, “They are the ones <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has sent to go throughout the earth.” [11] And they answered the messenger of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, who stood among the myrtle trees, and said, “We have gone throughout the earth, and see, all the earth is at peace and rest.” [12] And the messenger of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> answered and said, “O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, how long would <dn>You</dn> have no compassion on Yerushalayim and on the cities of Yehuḏah, against which <dn>You</dn> were enraged these seventy years?” [13] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> answered the messenger who talked to me, good words, comforting words. [14] And the messenger who spoke with me said to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, <dq>“<dn>I</dn> have been jealous for Yerushalayim and for Tsiyon with great jealousy. [15] And <dn>I</dn> am very wroth with the nations who are at ease, for when <dn>I</dn> was a little wroth, they furthered the evil!” [16] Therefore thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “<dn>I</dn> shall return to Yerushalayim with compassion. <dn>My</dn> house shall be built in it,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, <dq>“and a surveyor’s line be stretched out over Yerushalayim.” ’ [17] Again proclaim, saying, ‘Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, “Again <dn>My</dn> cities shall overflow with goodness. And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall again comfort Tsiyon, and shall again choose Yerushalayim.” ’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Vision of Four Horns and Four Craftsmen
readings.subtitle: The Powers That Scattered Judah Are Cast Down
readings.text: [Zechariah 1:18] And I lifted up my eyes and looked, and saw four horns. [19] And I said to the messenger who was speaking to me, “What are these?” And he said to me, “These are the horns that have scattered <dn>את</dn> Yehuḏah, <dn>את</dn> Yisra’ěl, and <dn>את</dn> Yerushalayim.” [20] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> showed me four craftsmen. [21] And I said, “What are these coming to do?” And he spoke saying, “These are the horns that scattered Yehuḏah, so that no one lifted up his head. But these come to trouble them, to throw down <dn>את</dn> the horns of the nations that lifted up their horn against the land of Yehuḏah to scatter it.”

readings.title: The Vision of the Measuring Line
readings.subtitle: A Wall of Fire Around Jerusalem
readings.text: [Zechariah 2:1] And I lifted up my eyes and looked, and saw a man with a measuring line in his hand. [2] And I said, “Where are you going?” And he said to me, “To measure Yerushalayim, to see what is its width and what is its length.” [3] And see, the messenger who was speaking to me was going out. And another messenger was coming out to meet him, [4] and he said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Yerushalayim is to remain unwalled, because of the many men and livestock in it. [5] <dq>For <dn>I</dn> <dn>Myself</dn> am to her,’</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>’a wall of fire all around, and for esteem <dn>I</dn> am in her midst.’ ”</dq>

readings.title: A Call to Flee Babylon
readings.subtitle: He Who Touches You Touches the Apple of My Eye
readings.text: [Zechariah 2:6] <dq>“Oh, Oh! And flee from the land of the north,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“for <dn>I</dn> have scattered you like the four winds of the heavens,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [7] <dq>“Oh, Tsiyon! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Baḇel.” [8] For thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts (for the sake of esteem <dn>He</dn> sent me to the nations which plunder you): “For he who touches you touches the apple of <dn>My</dn> eye. [9] For look, <dn>I</dn> am waving <dn>My</dn> hand against them, and they shall become spoil for their servants. And you shall know that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts has sent <dn>Me</dn>. [10] Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Tsiyon! For look, <dn>I</dn> am coming, and shall dwell in your midst,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [11] <dq>“And many nations shall be joined to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in that day, and they shall become <dn>My</dn> people. And <dn>I</dn> shall dwell in your midst. And you shall know that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts has sent <dn>Me</dn> to you. [12] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall inherit Yehuḏah, <dn>His</dn> portion in the Set-apart Land. And <dn>He</dn> shall again choose Yerushalayim. [13] Hush, all flesh, before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, for <dn>He</dn> has roused <dn>Himself</dn> out of <dn>His</dn> set-apart dwelling!”</dq>

readings.title: The Vision of Joshua the High Priest
readings.subtitle: A Brand Plucked from the Fire
readings.text: [Zechariah 3:1] And he showed me <dn>את</dn> Yehoshua the high priest standing before the messenger of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and Satan standing at his right hand to be an adversary to him. [2] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to Satan, <dq>“<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> rebuke you, Satan! <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> who has chosen Yerushalayim rebuke you! Is this not a brand plucked from the fire?”</dq> [3] And Yehoshua was dressed in filthy garments, and was standing before the messenger. [4] And <dn>He</dn> answered and spoke to those who stood before <dn>Him</dn>, saying, <dq>“Remove the filthy garments from him.”</dq> And to him <dn>He</dn> said, <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> have removed your guilt from you, and shall put costly robes on you.”</dq> [5] And I said, “Let them put a clean turban on his head.” Then they put a clean turban on his head, and they put garments on him. And the messenger of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> stood by. [6] And the messenger of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> witnessed to Yehoshua, saying, [7] <dq>“Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, ‘If you walk in <dn>My</dn> ways, and if you guard <dn>My</dn> duty, then you shall also rule <dn>My</dn> house, and also guard <dn>My</dn> courts. And <dn>I</dn> shall give you access among these standing here. [8] Now listen, Yehoshua the high priest, you and your companions who sit before you, for they are men of symbol. For look, <dn>I</dn> am bringing forth <dn>My</dn> Servant – the Branch. [9] See the stone which <dn>I</dn> have put before Yehoshua: on one stone are seven eyes. See, <dn>I</dn> am engraving its inscription,’</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, <dq>’and <dn>I</dn> shall remove <dn>את</dn> the guilt of that land in one day. [10] In that day,’</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, <dq>‘you shall invite one another, under the vine and under the fig tree.’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Vision of the Golden Lampstand
readings.subtitle: Not by Might, Nor by Power, but by My Spirit
readings.text: [Zechariah 4:1] And the messenger who was speaking to me came back and woke me up as a man is awakened from sleep. [2] And he said to me, “What do you see?” So I said, “I have looked, and see: a lampstand all of gold with a bowl on top of it, and on the stand seven lamps with seven spouts to the seven lamps. [3] “And two olive trees are by it, one at the right of the bowl and the other at its left.” [4] Then I responded and spoke to the messenger who was speaking to me, saying, “What are these, my master?” [5] And the messenger who was speaking to me answered and said to me, “Do you not know what these are?” And I said, “No, my master.” [6] And he answered and said to me, “This is the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to Zerubbaḇel, <dq>‘Not by might nor by power, but by <dn>My</dn> Spirit,’</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts. [7] <dq>Who are you, great mountain, before Zerubbaḇel? A plain! And he shall bring forth <dn>את</dn> the capstone with shouts of “Favour, favour to it!” ’ ”</dq> [8] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying, [9] <dq>“The hands of Zerubbaḇel have laid the foundation of this House, and his hands shall complete it. And you shall know that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts has sent <dn>Me</dn> to you. [10] For who has despised the day of small beginnings? They shall rejoice when they see <dn>את</dn> the plumb-line in the hand of Zerubbaḇel. These seven are the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, which diligently search throughout all the earth.”</dq> [11] Then I responded and said to him, “What are these two olive trees, one at the right of the lampstand and the other at its left?” [12] And I responded a second time and said to him, “What are these two olive branches which empty golden oil from themselves by means of the two gold pipes?” [13] And he answered me and said, “Do you not know what these are?” And I said, “No, my master.” [14] And he said, “These are the two anointed ones, who stand beside the Master of all the earth.”

readings.title: The Vision of the Flying Scroll
readings.subtitle: The Curse upon the Land
readings.text: [Zechariah 5:1] And I lifted up my eyes again, and looked and saw a flying scroll. [2] And he said to me, “What do you see?” And I answered, “I see a flying scroll, twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.” [3] And he said to me, “This is the curse that goes forth over the face of all the earth: ‘everyone who is stealing shall go unpunished,’ on the one side, according to it, and, ‘everyone who has sworn falsely shall go unpunished,’ on the other side, according to it.” [4] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> shall send it out,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, <dq>“and it shall come into the house of the thief and the house of the one who shall swear falsely by <dn>My</dn> Name. And it shall remain in the midst of his house and shall consume <dn>את</dn> it, both its timber and <dn>את</dn> its stones.”</dq>

readings.title: The Vision of the Woman in the Ephah
readings.subtitle: Wrongness Removed to Shinar
readings.text: [Zechariah 5:5] And the messenger who was speaking with me came out and said to me, “Lift up your eyes now, and see what this is that is going forth.” [6] And I said, “What is it?” And he said, “It is an ěphah-measure that is going forth.” Again he said, “This is their appearance throughout the earth: [7] “And see, a lead cover lifted up, and this: a woman sitting inside the ěphah-measure!” [8] And he said, “This is Wrongness!” And he threw <dn>את</dn> her down into the ěphah-measure, and threw the lead weight over its mouth. [9] And I lifted up my eyes, and looked and saw two women, coming with the wind in their wings. And they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up <dn>את</dn> the ěphah-measure between earth and the heavens. [10] Then I said to the messenger who was speaking to me, “Where are they taking the ěphah-measure?” [11] And he said to me, “To build a house for it in the land of Shin‛ar. And it shall be established and set there on its own base.”
